en.topic_title: All five defendants in San Po Kong subversion case intend to plead guilty, court hears
en.topic_summary:
Two men have told a Hong Kong court that they intend to plead guilty to conspiracy to commit subversion after they were arrested on suspicion of illegal weapons training in an industrial building in San Po Kong.



District Court in Wan Chai. File photo: HKFP.



Student Tang Ngai-pok and waiter Chan Hiu-chun appeared at the District Court on Thursday, local media reported. The defence told Judge Stanley Chan that the duo planned to plead guilty to the charges.
